name: Wearing hair natural in later life
what_people_do: Stop relaxing and wearing complex styles; wear the natural texture.
why_they_say_it_works: Confidence, identity and less time and cost; resistance to Eurocentric standards.

documented_by.source: Hair identity and wellbeing of older Black women, UK, 2025, J Women Aging, PMID 39921474
documented_by.quote_or_summary: UK survey of 46 and 10 interviews of older Black women: less frequent complex styles and fewer salon visits over 30 years; subjective wellbeing strengthened by confidence in own hair.

documented_by.source: Hair grooming practices of women of African descent in London, 2016, J Eur Acad Dermatol Venereol, PMID 27038251
documented_by.quote_or_summary: London, 242 women: natural hairstyles the most frequent current style (52.6%).

evidence.finding: Qualitative link between hair confidence and wellbeing; not a health outcome trial.

source.name: Hair identity and wellbeing of older Black women, UK, 2025, J Women Aging, PMID 39921474
